transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have the mediation scheduled for next Wednesday, and as we all know, the former sales manager is asserting discrimination and retaliation claims and demanding $180,000 to settle. This meeting is our required decision point — I need to set our final resolution authority and settlement terms before we adjourn, so we won't be scheduling another review. Before I do that, I need to hear from both of you. Let's start with HR — please share any relevant case information you have, particularly anything from the personnel file or beyond what's documented as the termination for performance reasons. Then I'll need insurance claims counsel to report any relevant coverage information. Once I've heard from both of you, I'll record our final resolution package.
